# Signet — Your agent. Your authority.

Signet is an open-source personal authority stack written in Rust. It combines
an encrypted vault, a policy engine, selective proof processing, and an MCP
interface. The user remains the source of delegated authority in its trust model.

## Install the vault CLI

Requires Rust 1.85+ and Git:

```sh
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/jmcentire/signet.git signet
signet init
signet vault-status
signet serve
```

The source installation and MCP client setup are documented at
https://signet.tools/start/. Do not use `cargo install signet` for this project.
Use test data while evaluating the stack; keep recovery material private.

## Components

- signet-core: shared types and interfaces.
- signet-vault: encrypted storage, key hierarchy, and audit chain.
- signet-policy: request evaluation and permit/deny/anomaly decisions.
- signet-notify: authorization notification and response handling.
- signet-cred: credential processing, authority, and capability verification.
- signet-proof: proof planning, execution, and presentation binding.
- signet-sdk: service-facing verification and integration surfaces.
- signet-mcp: MCP request handling and middleware.
- signet: local CLI and server entrypoints.

## Trust model

The vault is the root. The agent is the representative. The service is a
requester/verifier. Tier 1 supports provable claims; Tier 2 is agent-internal
context; Tier 3 requires an explicit authorization boundary. The homepage's
interactive examples illustrate these distinctions and do not perform real
proof generation, credential issuance, or payment operations.

Generic capability verification binds an envelope to the expected issuer,
domain, purpose, financial context, and validity window. The current generic
envelope is Signet envelope v1, not PASETO. Issuance fails closed without a
configured trusted issuer. Generic one-time capabilities are disabled until
there is a consumption ledger. A separately named delegated-provider envelope
has its own exact-context acceptance boundary.

Read the authoritative contracts:
- https://github.com/jmcentire/signet/blob/main/docs/capability-verification-boundary-2026-06-04.md
- https://github.com/jmcentire/signet/blob/main/docs/delegated-provider-authorization-boundary-2026-06-04.md
- https://github.com/jmcentire/signet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Companion: Signet Eval

Signet Eval is a separate tool-call policy engine:

```sh
cargo install signet-eval
```

Its repository is https://github.com/jmcentire/signet-eval.
The existing /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json describes that companion's
management interface, not the vault CLI. Consult the companion repository for
current supported hosts and configuration.

## Project status

Signet is under active development. Source/tests are inspectable. Production
credentials are forbidden in source, test fixtures, and CI artifacts; generated
test keys and documented test vectors are permitted. Passing local tests or a
published release does not establish production custody readiness.
